ctaBanner.title: Have a project idea but not sure where to start?
ctaBanner.text: Tell me what you want to build, and I’ll help turn it into a clear technical plan.

q1.q: How long does it take to build a project?
q1.a: A timeline is estimated before development begins based on your specific requirements. Business websites typically take 1–2 weeks to complete, while e-commerce platforms range from 3–6 weeks depending on features and integrations. Custom systems vary by scope and are scoped during our initial consultation. The timeline is reviewed and agreed upon before any development work starts.

q2.q: Do you provide hosting and domain setup?
q2.a: Yes, every project is deployed and configured for production before handover. I handle deployment on platforms like Vercel, Netlify, or Render, and can also set up dedicated servers depending on your requirements. Domain configuration, SSL certificates, and environment setup are all included. The project is delivered fully production-ready.

q3.q: Do you provide an admin dashboard?
q3.a: Dashboards are custom-built when your project requires management of users, content, products, orders, or permissions. Each dashboard is tailored to your specific business workflow rather than using a generic template. Features like role-based access, reporting, and analytics are included based on your operational needs.

q4.q: Can the project be expanded later?
q4.a: Yes, the architecture is designed to be scalable from the start. New features can be added without rewriting the existing codebase, which saves both time and cost. This approach avoids the need to rebuild from scratch when your business grows or requirements change.

q5.q: Do you provide maintenance and updates?
q5.a: Ongoing maintenance is available and can be arranged to suit your needs. This includes bug fixes, security updates, performance improvements, and feature additions. Regular monitoring and updates keep the project stable, secure, and performing well over time.

q6.q: What happens after the project is launched?
q6.a: After launch, I verify that everything is running correctly in the production environment and monitor for any issues. I remain available to address post-launch adjustments, implement improvements, and support future growth. Long-term collaboration is welcome if you need ongoing development or support.

q7.q: Do I need technical knowledge before starting?
q7.a: No technical knowledge is required on your end. You only need to explain your business idea, goals, and what you want the project to achieve. I handle all the technical planning, architecture decisions, and implementation from start to finish.

q8.a: The project starts with an initial discussion where I learn about your business, goals, and requirements. Based on that conversation, I define the project scope, estimate the timeline and cost, and present a clear plan before any development begins. Once the plan is agreed, development starts with regular updates throughout the process.
